Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and optionally to compound_structures on molregno to retrieve SMILES. Filter by the document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5260832. Order the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID.
